subject: Vacant Properties Ordinance Update
overview: The committee met to discuss a proposal updating the city's vacant properties ordinance and voted to keep the item in committee for further edits and legal review.

items.title: Vacant Properties Ordinance Proposal
items.summary: The committee reviewed a draft ordinance establishing an escalating fee structure and online registry for vacant commercial properties, ultimately voting to keep the proposal in committee for further edits and a legal review by KP Law.
